_about: Model benchmark queue for local_campaign_bench.py queue. Copy to bench/queue.local.json and edit. host is any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (llama-server, Ollama, vLLM...). server_cmd is optional: a shell command that (re)starts the server on {model}, with {extra} replaced by the entry's server_extra; leave it empty when the server is already running. pre_cmd is optional and runs before each entry (e.g. to make sure a tunnel is open).
